entries.en: to bestow; to give (a favour)
entries.notes: R栏音注污损难辨（T99）；西语词头 enrostro 读法难解且与汉字栏「施」（施予）不合，释义以汉字栏为准。

entries.en: to give gratis (dar de gracia); cf. to sell (售)
entries.notes: 西语词头 dar de gracia（白白给予）与汉字栏「售」（卖出）不合，疑「售」为「受」（受取）之形近误记；zh 依汉字栏、en 依西语词头各取其义。

entries.en: to thank; to give thanks
to give gratis (dar de gracia); cf. to enlighten, to guide (迪)
entries.notes: M栏音注污损难辨（T99）；且西语词头（白给）与汉字栏「迪」（启迪）不合，zh 依汉字栏、en 依西语词头各取其义。

entries.en: to give back, return (what is owed); to repay; to go round, turn
entries.notes: M栏附加音节读法存疑（[疑:ox/or]）；核心「还 huān」与 dar bueltas 于「归还」义相合。

entries.en: to give on credit; to take/receive on credit (dar en fiado)
entries.notes: R栏读法存疑（[疑:leng/keng]）；「领」与 dar en fiado（赊予/赊领）相合。

entries.en: to give on credit (dar enfiado); to reproach to the face (dar enrostro); cf. to fear (畏)
entries.notes: 词头读法存疑（[疑:enostros/enrostros]）且与汉字栏「畏」（畏惧）不合，各依本栏释义。

entries.en: to topple, turn upside down (颠倒)
entries.notes: 西语词头 cancadilla 难解（[疑:cancadilla/canca di lla]），en 依汉字栏「颠（倒）」义给出。

entries.zh: 给予、发给（上司发给薪俸）
entries.en: for the superior to give a stipend or salary (salario); to pay
entries.notes: M、R栏音注均污损（T99）；词尾 difensio 读法存疑，据 M 栏西语旁注 Salario（薪俸）定为「发给薪俸」义。

entries.en: for the superior to bestow; to grant
to bestow by authority; to confer
to strike with the fan in the hand; to pat
entries.notes: 词头拼写存疑（[疑:abanico/abaniure]）；「拍」与手持扇拍打之义相合。

entries.en: to give thanks (dar gracias); cf. to receive a favour (蒙)
entries.notes: R栏残缺（[残]）；西语 dar gracias（致谢）与汉字栏「蒙」（蒙受）不合，各依本栏释义。

entries.en: to thank; to give thanks
entries.notes: M栏尾音读法存疑（[疑:cam nia/camilla]）；核心「谢」与 dar gracias 相合。

entries.en: to give many thanks; to thank

entries.zh: 布施、分散给予（分给食物）
entries.en: to give out, distributing (food); to dispense, spread
to distribute and set out; to arrange
entries.notes: M栏音注污损（T99）；西语词头（分食分发）与汉字栏「布置」（安排摆放）不尽相合，zh 依汉字栏。

entries.en: to garrote; to strangle
to sentence to the garrote; crime punishable by garroting
entries.notes: M栏音注污损（T99）；「绞罪」与 dar garrote（处以绞刑）相合。

entries.en: to turn, spin like a wheel
entries.notes: R栏音注污损（T99）；「转」与 dar vueltas como rueda（如轮回转）相合。

entries.en: to give credit; to believe, trust
entries.notes: 汉字栏读法存疑（[疑:誠/誌]）；据 dar crédito 于马尼拉贸易语境（赊账信用）取「诚信/给信用」义。

entries.en: to congratulate; to wish well (dar el parabién)
entries.notes: M栏多处音注污损（T99）；「庆贺」与 dar el parabién（道贺）相合。
